effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon with the [System], [Life] or [Transmutation (App Name)] trait gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) for the turn.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 level 3 Digimon card with the [Appmon] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
xros_req:
[App Fusion] [Hackmon] & [Protecmon] & [Pipomon]: Cost 0
If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.
link_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] You may play 1 level 3 [Appmon] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
